uniteDbPokemon.notes: Unite-DB public pokemon.json. v3 enumerates skills, boosted basic attacks, nested upgrade choices, Plus/enhanced effects, Unite Moves, and Unite Buffs.

sourceList.originalDescription: Reduces the duration of hindrances inflicted on the user by an increased amount. When a hindrance is inflicted on Bounsweet, Steenee; decrease the duration of the effect.
Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack, lunging at an opposing Pokémon, damage nearby opposing Pokémon and lowering the Defense of those hit by 20% for 1s.
Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack, lunging at an opposing Pokémon, damage nearby opposing Pokémon and lowering the Defense of those hit by 20% for 1s.

The user pelts sharp-edged leaves in the designated direction, damaging opposing Pokémon hit up to 3 times. The critical-hit rate of this move is increased by 15%. Pelts leaves in the designated direction, dealing damage to enemies hit. The critical-hit rate of this move is higher than that of basic attacks.

The user dashes forward with 3 spinning kicks, hitting opposing Pokémon in the area of effect of each kick; increasing the user's auto attack speed for 5s per opposing Pokémon hit (up to 3 times), and increasing the damage of the user's auto attacks and Triple Axel by 8% per opposing Pokémon hit before dealing damage (up to 6 times). Queenly Majesty Effect: Restores HP per opposing Pokémon hit with each kick. 4% + (1.5% x (Level -1)) Tsareena spin-kicks 3 times in the designated direction, dealing damage to enemies. The damage dealt increases each time a kick hits, and basic attack speed is increased for a short time after this move ends by an amount based on the number of landed kicks. Queenly Majesty Effect: Restores HP each time a kick hits.

The user jumps up high and stomps the ground, damaging opposing Pokémon in the area of effect when they land and stunning them for 0.2s. Queenly Majesty Effect: Restores HP per opposing Pokémon hit. Tsareena jumps up high and attacks enemies their feet. When this move hits, deal damage to enemies and leave them unable to act for a short time. Queenly Majesty effect: Restores HP when this move hits.
Increases the damage of this move. Increased damage.

The user dashes forward and spins, damaging opposing Pokémon in their path and increasing the user's movement speed by 30% for 1.5s when it hits. Tsareena spins in the designated direction, dealing damage to any enemy hit. When this move hits, increase Tsareena's movement speed for a short time.

The user dashes forward with a flying kick of tropical origins, damaging opposing Pokémon in the path of the kick and decreasing their Attack by 25% for 1s when it hits. At the same time, a muddy wake is left in the path of the kick, damaging opposing Pokémon in the area of the wake (up to 7 times) and decreasing their movement speed by 35% for 1s. Queenly Majesty Effect: Grants the user a shield for 3s when this move is used. Perform a flying kick in the designated direction, dealing damage to enemies hit and decrease their Attack for a short time. Enemies that make contact with the flying kick's wake receive damage and have their movement speed decreased for a short time. Queenly Majesty effect: Grants Tsareena a shield when this move is used.
Increases the damage of this move. Increased damage.

The user dashes forward with a gliding kick, damaging opposing Pokémon hit. The user then immediately kicks back in the opposite direction, damaging and shoving opposing Pokémon hit backward. Queenly Majesty Effect: Grants the user a shield for 3s when this move is used. Tsareena slides in the designated direction, dealing damage to enemies hit and decreases their movement speed for a short time. This is followed by an attack in the opposite direction, dealing damage and shoving enemies hit. Queenly Majesty effect: Grants Tsareena a shield when this move is used.
Increases the damage of this move. Increased damage.

Tsareena leaps toward an enemy player and kicks it high into the air before showering it with a series of kicks while airborne, dealing damage to them. The moment Tsareena lands on the ground, recover HP. While airborne, the enemy that is being kicked and Tsareena are not affected by other moves. Tsareena leaps toward an enemy from the opposing team and kicks it high into the air before showering it with a series of kicks while airborne, dealing damage to them. The moment Tsareena lands on the ground, recover HP. While airborne, the enemy that is being kicked and Tsareena are not affected by other moves.
Buffs: 30% Movement Speed, 30% CDR, 20% Max HP Shield Buff duration: 6
